title: India U19 Face Unbeaten Afghanistan in Asia Cup Semi-Final on Thursday
excerpt: Afghanistan topped their group without a defeat and India rode Aaryavir Sehwag's 160 into the last four. Here is when the semi-final starts and where to watch it in India and North America.
body:
• India Under-19 play Afghanistan Under-19 in the second semi-final of the ACC Men's U19 Asia Cup on Thursday, November 12, 2026, at the Al Amerat Cricket Ground in Oman, starting 10:30 a.m. IST.
  • Afghanistan topped Group B without a defeat; India reached the last four after Aaryavir Sehwag's 160 powered them past the UAE.
  • In India the match is on Sony Sports Network and SonyLIV; viewers in the US and Canada can watch on Willow TV, from 9:00 p.m. PT on Wednesday.
  • The winners play the final on Saturday, November 14.

India Under-19 will play Afghanistan Under-19 in the second semi-final of the ACC Men's U19 Asia Cup 2026 on Thursday, November 12, at the Al Amerat Cricket Ground in Oman, with a place in Saturday's final at stake, according to the tournament listings published by CricTracker and SportsDunia. The 50-over match is scheduled to start at 10:30 a.m. IST, with the toss half an hour earlier.

How the teams got here

Afghanistan come into the semi-final as Group B toppers and the tournament's unbeaten side, a run that has made them the team to beat in the knockouts. India finished as runners-up in Group A and sealed their semi-final place with a win over the United Arab Emirates, a match in which opener Aaryavir Sehwag scored 160. The first semi-final, between Pakistan and Bangladesh, is being played the same day at the same venue complex, and the two winners meet in the final on Saturday, November 14.

Where to watch

In India, the semi-final will be telecast live on the Sony Sports Network and streamed on SonyLIV, according to SportsDunia's broadcast guide. The same guide lists PTV Sports and Geo Super for Pakistan, Sky Sports in the UK, Amazon Prime Video in Australia and Sky Sport Now in New Zealand, with the Asian Cricket Council's channels carrying the tournament in several other territories. Cricfacts' viewing guide lists Willow TV for the United States and Canada. For North American viewers the start time is 9:00 p.m. Pacific on Wednesday night, or midnight Eastern. Live scores and ball-by-ball commentary are on the Cricbuzz match page.

What is at stake

India are the most successful side in the tournament's history at this level, but youth Asia Cups have repeatedly produced upsets at the semi-final stage, and Afghanistan's age-group teams have built a reputation for disciplined bowling attacks that defend modest totals. For India's batters, the test is whether the form shown against the UAE holds against a stronger attack; for Afghanistan, a win would put them in the final unbeaten. Either way, the winner faces a short turnaround before Saturday's final at the same ground.
